reuse.why: Extends the existing getBudgetData query and keeps setBudget/batchMessages; the saved-template check parses goal_def itself rather than through goal-template's template reading, which is reasonable since only presence matters.

duplication.why: Replaces three identical category queries with one getMonthActionCategories and states the skip rule once in isSkippedByMonthActions.

placement.why: Rule and query helper live in server/budget/actions.ts next to the month-wide actions that use them.

scope.why: Only month-wide actions plus a release note; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: One predicate for 'skipped by month actions' used by every month-wide action; two category-fetching queries (getBudgetData joins and getMonthActionCategories) still coexist, and hasSavedTemplates treats unparsable JSON as a template, a silent policy choice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through isSkippedByMonthActions.

disguised_duplication.where: The former SQL hidden filters were removed in favour of the shared predicate, not restated.

one_place.where: isSkippedByMonthActions in server/budget/actions.ts is the single definition used by copyPreviousMonth (via getBudgetData rows) and by setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg (via getMonthActionCategories).
